description.value:
Many are quick to underestimate people who use a cane. Use that.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic Medium Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: 4m/yds

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When this weapon deals damage through a target’s armor, the user decides whether the target also suffers the effect of EMP or Poison Ammunition in addition to any regular damage. Either ammunition effect can only be applied once per Round by this weapon. Whenever this weapon causes a Critical Injury, it deals an additional 5 Bonus Damage (10 total). If damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, the user can choose to leave their target Unconscious at 1 HP instead.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: 4m/yds

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
